reason: It's free and it kills the app-juggling - Death Note and ORV in one scroll where it remembers my spot, with the chat sitting right next to it instead of me alt-tabbing to Discord every page. Costs nothing to try, so I'd click the link and read.
objection: It only has Death Note and ORV - why not everything? And my actual group already lives in our Discord channel, so if nobody else migrates, the chat room is just a dead second place I have to check.
would_change_my_mind: If the group keeps talking in Discord anyway and the site's chat stays empty, I'd stop opening it within a week.
